text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite some declines, and doing nothing was often a reasonable choice; I should not trade without a clear reason.","Selling some Stock B at a gain did not require selling the rest or predicting its next move; I should base each decision on current prospects, not past gains or losses.","I should protect myself from loss-driven, frequent reactions by checking less obsessively and making deliberate decisions rather than chasing short-term price changes."]}
